title: Correctness is a for-all; minimality is a non-existence
statement: Equivalence of two programs is a universal statement discharged once per rewrite. Minimality is the non-existence of any shorter program in a declared space -- and non-existence is exactly what a refutation proof is for. Twenty years of verified compilation certify the first; nothing certifies the second.

formal.statement: equiv: forall s, p1 s = p2 s.  minimal: not exists q in S, cost q < cost p and forall s, q s = p s.
